_comment: Single source of truth for the current monthly workshop. Edited each month by the workshop skill, then used to regenerate the funnel. Date is Melbourne local; the skill works out the timezone (AEST/AEDT) automatically.
_title_comment: DESCRIBES the workshop, never a product name. It surfaces on the thank-you page tab and (via calendarSummary) in the calendar event people add. It said 'The Unfair Advantage' until 5 Aug 2026, which is the MEMBERSHIP's name, so registrants were adding a calendar event named after the paid offer. Never reuse a Pack name here either ('The Content Advantage' is August's paid Pack and owns that name exclusively). Keep it in step with the live page <title>.

_reminderPrep_comment: Topic-specific prep for the day-before email. Write it for each month. Left out for December 2026 (November's was removed), so the generator falls back to generic copy.
holdingTeaser: In one hour, leave with a simple content system for your business, and watch a talking-head reel go from raw clip to finished post with Claude.
_replayUrl_comment: The Descript share link for THIS month's replay. Leave empty until the cut exists. Follow-up email 1 carries it, and kit-workshop.mjs REFUSES to schedule that email while this is empty, so the replay promise can never go out unbacked. Clear it again at rollover.
_membershipPrice_comment: The Unfair Advantage monthly price at the time the follow-up emails send. The rate steps up ON the workshop date, never the 1st of the month, so this is the post-workshop price.
_invitePitch_comment: Topic-specific pitch for the two WHOLE-LIST run-up invites (invitePitch and inviteShort). Write them for each month. Left out for December 2026 (November's were removed): write December's before generating the invite emails, or the generator falls back to a bare one-liner built from the topic.
_cohortTagId_comment: The Kit tag for THIS month's sign-ups (workshop-2026-12). The sign-up function finds the tag by name and creates it on the first sign-up, so this id is only for the workshop skill's emails. Null until that tag exists; never put an earlier month's tag here.
